fields.label: Line ID
fields.description: Stable identifier generated on insert. Style BOM Override rows join to this. Never recomputed - row order (idx) is not safe to key on, since reordering/deleting a line would silently re-point overrides.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: The Item template if this line varies by colour/size, otherwise the concrete item.

fields.label: Base Consumption
fields.description: Per garment, at base size. Always populated - this is the fallback when no override applies.

fields.label: Resolution Rule
fields.options:
Fixed
Match garment colour
Match garment size
Explicit Override

fields.label: Position
fields.description: Placement on the garment, e.g. 'CB neck'.
